relations.name: source_invoice
relations.meaning: One represented billed-revenue invoice row as recorded in billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/billing/invoices.json by invoice_id.
relations.construction_rule: Compile one tuple per invoices.json object; mint invoice referent billing:<invoice_id>; copy fields verbatim.

relations.name: source_crm_account
relations.meaning: One CRM account record with its sourced display name.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/crm.csv by crm_account_id.
relations.construction_rule: Compile one tuple per CRM row; mint account referent crm:<crm_account_id>; copy account_name verbatim.

relations.name: source_registry_entity
relations.meaning: One company-registry row with registered legal name and company number.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/company_registry.csv by company_number.
relations.construction_rule: Compile one tuple per registry row; mint entity referent registry:<company_number>; copy legal_name verbatim.

relations.name: source_contract
relations.meaning: One contract or statement-of-work document with source-native identifier and counterparty line.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/contracts/<filename> header Counterparty line.
relations.construction_rule: Compile one tuple per .md contract file; mint contract referent contract:<basename without .md>; contract_id is basename without extension; extract counterparty_text from Counterparty header.

relations.name: contract_active_status
relations.meaning: Whether a contract or SOW is currently in force according to sourced effective, term, and expiry facts.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to contract header dates/term text and explicit expiry or expired markers in the source file.
relations.construction_rule: Parse Effective, Term, Expiry, and explicit expired/not-renewed statements deterministically; active=false when an explicit expiry date has passed or the document states the SOW has expired.

relations.name: contract_clause
relations.meaning: A contract bears a sourced clause or term-mechanics category present in its text.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded evidence packet quoting the clause or term language that supports the classified kind.
relations.construction_rule: For each contract, classify present clause kinds from contract body and term mechanics; emit one tuple per accepted kind.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Enumerate contracts from source_contract crossed with the union of Purpose A acquisition-relevant kinds and Purpose C obligation kinds.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether contract text constitutes the candidate clause_kind.

relations.name: identity_judgment
relations.meaning: Two typed commercial identifiers denote the same legal counterparty, are distinct, or remain unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet; SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT require establishing evidence, not mere name compatibility.
relations.construction_rule: Resolve each candidate pair to SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or UNRESOLVED with cited source evidence; mechanical legal-form equivalence may ground SAME_ENTITY without fuzzy matching.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Emit directed pairs required by Purpose B link pattern connecting crm:, billing:, contract:, and registry: identifiers for each commercially relevant relationship, plus exact legal-form variant pairs.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether left and right typed identifiers refer to the same legal counterparty.

relations.name: identity_link_candidate
relations.meaning: A directed pair of typed identifiers that Purpose B requires be judged for sameness.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation inputs list the source relations used to enumerate each endpoint.
relations.construction_rule: Derive the required crm-billing-contract-registry link pairs per commercially relevant relationship from compiled source relations and commercial_notes.md relationship hints; do not assign a disposition.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: For each CRM account with billing or contract footprint, emit pairs linking crm:<id>, billing:<billed_name>, contract:<basename>, and registry:<company_number> candidates.

relations.name: open_invoice
relations.meaning: An invoice whose sourced payment status is open.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation grounded to source_invoice rows where status equals open.
relations.construction_rule: SELECT invoice and invoice_id FROM source_invoice WHERE status = 'open'.

relations.name: invoice_contract_association
relations.meaning: For Purpose A reporting, whether an invoice is confidently linked to a governing contract counterparty or the join remains unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet citing identity_judgment chain from billing:<billed_name> to contract:<basename> counterparty or explicit uncertainty.
relations.construction_rule: For each in-scope invoice, pair with candidate governing contracts; map confident identity chain to disposition asserted, otherwise unresolved; never treat missing confidence as negative non-association.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Cross each source_invoice with source_contract rows reachable via identity_judgment from the invoice billed name to the contract counterparty_text.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the invoice billed name and contract counterparty are confidently the same commercial relationship for inclusion reporting.

relations.name: commercial_dependency_judgment
relations.meaning: For Purpose C, whether a counterparty-contract pair is commercially dependent or indeterminate due to unresolved joins.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet citing open_invoice, contract_active_status, contract_clause kinds, and any identity_judgment used to join endpoints.
relations.construction_rule: Apply Purpose C two-part test: current relationship via open invoice or active auto-renew/rolling contract plus qualifying obligation kinds; emit dependent when both parts hold with confident joins, otherwise unresolved.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Enumerate counterparty identifier and contract pairs where an open invoice or active contract with C obligation kinds is plausibly linked via identity_judgment.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the counterparty-contract pair satisfies the commercial dependency test with confident identity joins.
